card.name: Scattered words in label and press text
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on assorted words such as Observatory, up, a, have, studies, use, established and patients in label and news sentences.

modes.label: Words after a subject phrase
modes.description: Common words such as studies, use, patients or established that follow a topic phrase in warning text.
modes.example: Atomoxetine increased the risk of suicidal ideation in short-term<< studies>> in children or adolescents with Attention-Def

modes.label: Press release and news wording
modes.description: Words in news-style sentences, such as Observatory in a press release header or a in a source citation.
modes.example: Gemini<< Observatory>> Press Release For Immediate Release – February
